items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What do you think of a piece like Milhaud's Creation du Monde? [INTERVIEWEE] I think they call it jazz; I don't think it is.

ctx.x: We always felt that the jazz thing (inaudible). In my early years, I used to not want to mix it (inaudible). I don't think any of us would do it now or even attempt it.
What do you think of a piece like Milhaud's Creation du Monde?
I think they call it jazz; I don't think it is.
